steps.note: The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
The milk is soured with a little of the last batch of skyr, whose bacteria make acid in it.
The whey runs off, and what stays in the cloth is the skyr.

processing.text: A dairy may strain the soured milk by ultrafiltration instead, after thermising it at about 55 degrees C for 3 min, as it does concentrated yoghurt.
